meta.title: Product-intent confirmation record
meta.note: SUPERSEDED 2026-11-20 by data/product-intent.json (canonical). Statuses below are aligned to the canonical register: four links observed to resolve to product pages (observed_only), one unresolved. Intended ASINs remain unconfirmed for all five; the 9-character short-link slugs are not ASINs. Earlier notes in this file claiming the build environment could not reach Amazon were true of one build sandbox only and are retracted.
